text:
Devin: midday handoff — quick check
Devin: cluster steady. Noticeable cache warmup traffic after the 11:00 canary; prefetcher hit-rate at ~72% (normal ~90%)
deploy-bot: deploy redwood/inference-api v3.5.0-canary started at 1972103000 :rocket:
Maya: saw a handful of slow embedding requests tied to model-pin rotation. Logs in /var/logs/model-rotation.log
Rahul: rolled model-pin back on two nodes (node-14, node-17) at 11:20 to relieve pressure
Devin: items to watch: 1) prefetch.hit_rate (alert <60) 2) embeddings.latency.p95 (alert >700ms) 3) prefetch.queue.depth (alert >40)
Sasha: FYI two PRs in flight that touch prefetcher policy: #4602 (prefetch TTL) @Maya, #4610 (node drain behavior) @Rahul — both need review
Maya: quick repro for the embedding lag:
`````
export MODEL=embed-redwood-2b
rbctl model pin --nodes=node-14,node-17
ab -n 50 -c 5 http://localhost:8080/embedding
`````
Devin: mitigation if embedding latency spikes: disable prefetcher with `rbctl prefetch set --enabled=false` and move traffic to the warm pool: `rbctl routing set --pool=warm --weight=1.0`
oncall-bot: reminder: paging profile set to "oncall" for this channel. Use `@oncall-email` to escalate.
Devin: customer support note: CS-2052 reported higher latency for an internal integration test — assigned to Maya
Rahul: I'll watch the warm pool and node drains. If the canary causes new spikes I can cut it back to 10% and re-run health checks
Sasha: I'll be offline 13:00-14:00 PT but reachable for urgent pings. Please tag @oncall-email if you need escalation
Devin: leaving this on the board under "midday watch 1972103456" with dashboard links: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/oncall/prefetch
Maya: ack — monitoring dashboards and CS ticket.
Devin: no active incidents. If anyone takes action, please add a short note to the runbook fragment so night crew can pick up.
Rahul: ack. Will update runbook and alert thresholds if needed.
Devin: handing off — back at 16:00 PT. Thanks.
